If the panel asks "where is the AI?"

A speech recognition service scores the reading and a formula based recommender suggests what to read next. The level moves, the practice tag and the alerts are written rules. We did not train a model and have no dataset of children's recordings.

What was set up for this run

Taken on 27 November 2026 on a practice copy with demo accounts. The reading was a computer voice, not a child. Some word lists were made so that voice reads clearly. The recommender's pick was entered by hand. The scoring, level moves, practice tag and teacher alerts are the app's own.
